title: Taking up trombone with Brady's instruments
summary: He started on cornet but preferred trombone, taking it up at eighteen to twenty on a cheap slide instrument Brady bought for the band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You started on carnet, was that You first...
Started on carnet, but I didn't like it I liked the tramo That was my instrument
How old were you when you started about How big of a kid?
Well, I was about Twenty years old Eighteen or twenty years old Something like that
Then when did you take up trombone? Pretty soon after that?
Yeah, I took up trombone Right after that And sent it to Brady Paid for that
What kind of trombone did you have?
Well, I'll tell you the truth I got a piece of that trombone now Got it right there in that drawer Piece of it here That show you how long I mean there
Was it a slide or a battle?

A slide, slide, yeah One of them cheap ones, you know He bought a whole gang of instruments He didn't... He got the cheapest You know, it was a high price He bought them from Royal Island But he had the whole thing Clannet player, trombone He had two trombones Two clannet Drum Oh, he had a great big band
Who was in it? Do you know the other guys now?
No, well, plenty of them is dead now They got a few of them is living there Real old Two
